metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Metallic Accent Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome close-up portrait featuring a subject with soft skin textures and sharp metallic-effect typography layered over the lower third.
triggerTerms: monochrome portrait with orange metallic text
beveled serif typography on black and white photo
close-up fashion photography with text overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate black-and-white portrait of a woman, characterized by soft-focus skin and high-contrast lighting that emphasizes the eyes and lips. The composition is anchored by a large, beveled metallic-orange serif title in the bottom right corner, contrasted against a smaller white serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome background vs. saturated metallic foreground text
Soft facial features vs. sharp, geometric typographic edges
Vertical arm placement framing the left side of the face
Dark, shadowed background focusing attention on the lit facial plane

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies approximately 70% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left with a hand framing the jawline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes serve as the primary focal point, while the large orange text in the bottom right provides a secondary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, and then follows the diagonal line to the text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the right side of the frame and the dark background provide negative space for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (shades of black, white, and silver-gray) for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and background depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic orange/copper with highlights for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face; zero saturation in the image vs. high saturation in the text.
paletteRestrictions: No primary colors except for the orange text accent
No color in the photographic subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a large x-height and sharp, bracketed serifs
Secondary text is significantly smaller with a lighter weight
Primary text features a 3D bevel and inner glow effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'j' in the primary text is oversized and descends below the baseline to create a hook-like anchor
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast between two weights of the same or similar serif family.

avoid: Flat colors for the primary title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic serif skeleton suitable for high-contrast treatments.
Offers a slightly larger x-height and robust serifs for the beveled effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a woman's face, with her hand resting against her cheek, soft lighting on the skin, and a dark, shadowed background on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, beveled metallic orange serif title in the bottom right corner. Above it, add a smaller, flat white serif subtitle. Ensure the orange text has a 3D embossed appearance.

verificationChecks: Does the primary text have a 3D metallic orange effect?
Is the composition a tight facial crop?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate exact jewelry designs

mustAchieve: Intimate eye contact in the portrait
avoid: Flat, unstyled text for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the face
Verify the orange text is beveled and metallic
Ensure the subtitle is white and smaller than the main title
Confirm the image is black and white except for the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Close-up Portrait + Beveled Metallic Serif Typography + Bottom-Right Alignment
